## Task: fix "makemigrations crashes for ForeignKey with mixed-case app name" (django__django-13112)

**Where:** the working repo for this session is `engine/live-test/work/django-13112-nopanel` (django @ `09914ccf68`, Jun 2020 — the parent of the upstream fix).
